cluster.headline: Antisemitism in France: 82% of Jews surveyed say they have experienced it, 64% have considered leaving (Ifop for AJC, 2027 edition)
cluster.body_note: Server-rendered English body fetched via WebFetch. Body states: published Nov 15 (no year on page), Ifop for AJC with Fondapol, '2027 edition', n=500 self-identified Jews, fieldwork July-September 2026; 82% lifetime antisemitic act, 60% insults, 35% threats of physical assault, two-thirds France not safe, 64% considered leaving (up 12 pts from 52% in 2024), 26% cite future of Jews in France as main reason; notes figures are self-reported, not recorded incidents.

sources.title: Radiographie de l'antisémitisme en France - Édition 2027 (étude AJC, en partenariat avec la Fondapol, réalisée par l'Ifop)
sources.methodology: Three online self-administered quota samples: 2,000 French adults 18+ (17-24 Sep 2026); 500 Muslims 18+ (17-28 Sep 2026); 500 self-declared Jewish French people drawn from cumulated national samples of 34,500 (29 Jul-28 Sep 2026). Report states it measures perceptions, does not count incidents. No margin of error published (quota method). PDF created 2026-11-10; 36 pages.

key_figures.lifetime_antisemitic_acts: 82% (Q: 'Au cours de votre vie, avez-vous, parce que vous étiez Juif, fait personnellement l'objet...?'; 40% physically aggressed person/property + 42% other acts; 18% no) - p.25 chart
key_figures.threats_of_aggression: 35% (+11) - item wording 'menaces d'agression sur vos biens ou votre personne'
key_figures.france_not_safe: 66% (45% plutôt pas sûr + 21% pas du tout sûr)
key_figures.considered_leaving: 64% TOTAL Oui (Q: 'Avez-vous déjà envisagé de quitter la France ?'); trend Nov 2019 52%, Jan 2022 46%, Mar 2024 52%, Sep 2026 64%; chart NB: 'les évolutions sont à considérer avec précaution en raison de l'ajout d'un item' - p.28
key_figures.leaving_reasons_base_all_jewish_responde: 26% fear for future of Jews in France (+5); 22% fear for future of France; 8% economic; 5% cultural/religious pull; 3% join family abroad (new item)

sources.title: JNS - 29% of French Jews have removed mezuzahs, poll finds (2026-11-17)
sources.note: Links the primary PDF; says poll published Monday (16 Nov 2026).

primary_source_search.note: Primary report's actual title is 'Radiographie de l'antisémitisme en France - Édition 2027' (i24 renders it 'A Snapshot of Antisemitism in France'). The '2027 edition' label is the report's own, despite Nov-2026 publication; title/edition/publication date are logistics/ordinals and not judged.

claims.claim_text: 82% of Jews surveyed say they have experienced [antisemitism]
claims.verified_source_figure: 82% of 500 self-declared Jewish respondents have been victims of at least one antisemitic act in their lifetime (p.25)
claims.note: Headline scopes to 'Jews surveyed'; lifetime frame is omitted in headline but stated in body. Not overstated.

claims.verified_source_figure: 64% answered yes to 'Avez-vous déjà envisagé de quitter la France ?' (p.28)
claims.note: Headline wording 'have considered' matches the question ('have you ever considered') more precisely than the report's own prose ('déclarent envisager').

claims.claim_text: More than eight in ten (82%) report at least one antisemitic incident in their lifetime

claims.verified_source_figure: 35% 'menaces d'agression sur vos biens ou votre personne' (+11 pts)
claims.note: Source item covers threats against property or person; 'physical assault' is a close translation, not material.

claims.claim_text: Two-thirds believe France is not a safe country for Jews
claims.verified_source_figure: 66% total not safe (45% rather not + 21% not at all) (p.25)

claims.claim_text: 64% have considered leaving France, up 12 points from 52% in 2024
claims.verified_source_figure: 64% Sep 2026 vs 52% Mar 2024 (+12, stated in report text p.28); chart NB warns trend must be read with caution because an answer item was added in 2026 (new 'join family abroad' option, 3%). Longer series: 52% (2019), 46% (2022).
claims.note: Figures correct and the 2024 baseline is simply the prior wave (not cherry-picked), but the article omits the source's own comparability caveat on the trend, which bears on how much of the +12 is real change.

claims.claim_text: 26% primarily cite concerns about the future of Jews in France; others cite the country's future, economic or family reasons
claims.verified_source_figure: Base = all Jewish respondents: 26% fear for future of Jews in France, 22% future of France, 8% economic, 5% cultural/religious pull, 3% family

claims.claim_text: Sample of 500 self-identified Jews, fieldwork July-September 2026
claims.verified_source_figure: 500 self-declared Jewish French people, 29 Jul-28 Sep 2026, from cumulated national samples of 34,500; online quota method
claims.note: No margin of error is published by the source; article does not claim one.

claims.claim_text: Survey measures self-reported experiences and perceptions, not incidents recorded by authorities
claims.verified_source_figure: Report: 'ne comptabilise pas les actes antisémites ... étudie la perception et le ressenti' (p.9)

scope_exclusions: Report title rendered as 'A Snapshot of Antisemitism in France' (actual: 'Radiographie de l'antisémitisme en France')
'2027 edition' label (publication ordinal; it is the report's own label)
